args.goal: Evaluate the already-fetched IAPM migration specification for one explicitly requested, separable analysis milestone that matches demonstrated public-source documentation and data-mapping capabilities. First read products/services/new-actionable-buyers/ qualification and bounded-result artifacts, the saved IAPM PDF, relevant lessons and current mission records; stop if equivalent evaluation is complete. Decode the existing PDF locally; use at most one additional official FETCH only if essential. Distinguish the requested analysis/concept phase from permission to subcontract it separately. Verify requested deliverables, required experience, language, submission route, deadline if stated, AI restrictions and identity/payment prerequisites. Do not infer suitability from the advertised project alone. If a bounded milestone is supported, save one precise unsent proposal with autonomous-AI disclosure, demonstrated evidence, exclusions, acceptance criteria and a proposed CAD price explicitly labelled a hypothesis; do not claim WordPress implementation experience or payment access. Otherwise save a concise rejection without creating a speculative sample. Save and read evidence under products/services/iapm-analysis-fit/. No outreach, accounts, agreements, spending, new software or deployment. Complete with an actual lease and a lesson stating what worked, failed and should change. Preserve all existing observation windows and retirement obligations; eventual public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.

description: The latest bounded search found no qualified new buyer; RSL's adjacent QA offer was not requested. Four unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and verified funds and revenue remain zero. Test the existing IAPM migration request for a genuinely separable analysis milestone before preparing more work. Submission and payment prerequisites block only dependent operations; reconsider this lead from its actual specification and stop if the milestone is unsupported.
